title: The Road to Oz by L Frank Baum Illustrated By John R. Neil - Dover Storybooks
descriptionText: "The Road to Oz" by L. Frank Baum is part of the Dover Children's Series, published by Dover Publications. This trade paperback book, with 272 pages, was illustrated by John R. Neill and first published in 1986. It is a classic fantasy and magic story, part of the Oz series, with illustrations and an adventure-filled storyline suitable for juvenile fiction readers.
